entities.label: Person
entities.summary: One of the most dramatic prophets of the Hebrew Bible (9th century BCE). Challenged King Ahab and the prophets of Baal on Mount Carmel, called Israel back to Yahweh worship, and ascended to heaven in a chariot of fire (2 Kings 2). Serves as a prototype of prophetic witness in both Judaism and Christianity.
